Pure-Python packages used by the in-browser console (docs/index.html), unchanged from PyPI:
  networkx-3.3-py3-none-any.whl        BSD-3-Clause   https://pypi.org/project/networkx/3.3/
  python_evtx-0.8.1-py3-none-any.whl   Apache-2.0     https://pypi.org/project/python-evtx/0.8.1/
  hexdump.py (hexdump 3.3)             Public Domain  https://pypi.org/project/hexdump/3.3/
Pyodide itself (CPython compiled to WebAssembly, MPL-2.0) is loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net.
